scope: Independent execution on frozen producer; report-only files created; mock/local scripted UI only; no credentials, environment files, human inputs, external API calls or Git mutation.

findings.summary: Legitimate partial assessment failures cannot replay because action input hash is stale after inquiry context/record insertion.
findings.reproduction: node --import tsx reports/working-inquiry-2026-10-30/independent-round1/verify.ts (four named partial-case logs retained); isolated replay: node --import tsx runner/virtual-beta-replay.ts reports/working-inquiry-2026-10-30/independent-round1/runs/assessment-http
findings.expected: Generated native/assessment/action provider and model-output failure records retain their original failure classification and pass replay integrity verification.
findings.actual: assessment-http, assessment-model, invalid-inquiry and invalid-assessment all terminate with the intended API_ERROR or INVALID_DISTRIBUTION but replay throws MODEL_INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH. Stored step.inputSha256 does not hash saved step.modelInput after workingInquiryContext/workingInquiry is added.
findings.impact: Comparison runner treats honest provider/model-output partials as integrity-invalid; violates fixed snapshot acceptance for valid partial failures.
findings.suggestedRepair: Synchronize step.inputSha256 after inserting workingInquiryContext and after inserting workingInquiry; retain original partial logs and rerun fresh cases against a new freeze.

verifierCorrections.issue: Initial verifier incorrectly asserted no existing deferral policy. That policy already belongs to both profiles and all observed weights were one.
verifierCorrections.resolution: Corrected independent audit asserts unchanged profile and all existing weights one; normal run and replay pass. Original logs preserved.

verifierCorrections.issue: Initial foreign-source test used placeholder image data, making rejection test nonspecific.
verifierCorrections.resolution: audit.ts rebuilds real image assets, first asserts valid exact derivation, then applies six one-field source/goal/after-memory mutants.
